biggest_catch: You must earn 500 approved points ($5) before the redemption button activates; then official processing takes about 1-3 business days.
catches: Redemption button activates only after 500 approved points ($5.00) are earned.
After selecting a reward, official processing takes about 1-3 business days for the money to deposit.
A valid phone number may be required to verify identity before cashing out.
Survey disqualification happens; Branded Surveys awards a few points for attempted qualifications.
Points must be approved (not pending) to count toward the 500 minimum.

c1.evidence: Official surveys.gobranded.com page: 'As soon as you earn 500 points, you can redeem them for a reward... Every 500 points are equivalent to $5 paid through PayPal or a $5 gift card. After selecting your reward, it takes about one to three business days for the money to deposit into your account.'
c1.note: The $5 minimum and 1-3 business day payout clock are official statements on the provider's own site.

c2.evidence: SurveyPolice quotes Branded Surveys' reward terms: 'Redemptions take approximately 1-2 business days to process, and all rewards are digital.' Bank-transfer (Branded Pay, USA only) posts within 24-48 hours of approval.
c2.note: Corroborates the official 1-3 business day clock; bank transfer option is USA-only.

eligibility: Free account; a valid phone number may be required for identity verification at cashout.
maximize: Redeem at the 500-point ($5) minimum via PayPal as soon as the redemption button activates; you don't have to wait for a set payday.
notes: Verified from official surveys.gobranded.com page (fetched 2026-09-23): $5/500-point minimum and 1-3 business day deposit clock are official. Third-party reviews (SurveyPolice, realwaystoearnmoneyonline) corroborate ~1-2 business days.
numeric_basis: payout: variable per survey; 500 points = $5; time: surveys average 10-12 min

Every 500 points are equivalent to $5 paid through PayPal or a $5 gift card. After selecting your reward, it takes about one to three business days for the money to deposit into your account.

steps: Create a free Branded Surveys account.
Take surveys and earn approved points (points awarded even for attempted qualifications).
Watch the top of your dashboard for the 500-point ($5) threshold.
Hit the redemption button and choose PayPal (or gift cards, bank transfer, prepaid cards).
Money deposits to your account about 1-3 business days later.
timing: Earn 500 approved points ($5) to activate redemption; after selecting your PayPal reward, money deposits in about one to three business days (official).
when_cash_arrives: After selecting your PayPal reward at 500 points, the money deposits in about 1-3 business days (official Branded Surveys terms).
